title: The image of one Lipschitz map ℝⁿ → ℝ^{n+ℓ} is covered, up to an Hⁿ-null set, by compact bi-Lipschitz pieces with continuous injective derivative (parent Steps 3–5)
statement: Let n, ℓ ∈ ℕ, ℝⁿ := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n), E := Ambient n ℓ = ℝ^{n+ℓ}, Hⁿ := μHE[n] the n-dimensional (Euclidean-normalized) Hausdorff measure on E, K ≥ 0, and let f: ℝⁿ → E be K-Lipschitz. Then there are a set Y ⊆ E with Hⁿ(Y) = 0 and sets C_i ⊆ ℝⁿ (i ∈ ℕ) with f(ℝⁿ) ⊆ Y ∪ ⋃_i f(C_i) such that, for every i: C_i is compact; f is differentiable at every w ∈ C_i and Df(w) is injective; w ↦ Df(w) = fderiv ℝ f w is continuous on C_i; and there is c > 0 with c|v − w| ≤ |f(v) − f(w)| for all v, w ∈ C_i.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (K : NNReal) (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → Ambient n ℓ), LipschitzWith K f → ∃ (Y : Set (Ambient n ℓ)) (C : ℕ → Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))), (μHE[n] : Measure (Ambient n ℓ)) Y = 0 ∧ Set.range f ⊆ Y ∪ ⋃ i, f '' C i ∧ ∀ i, IsCompact (C i) ∧ (∀ w ∈ C i, DifferentiableAt ℝ f w ∧ Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ f w)) ∧ ContinuousOn (fderiv ℝ f) (C i) ∧ ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ v ∈ C i, ∀ w ∈ C i, c * ‖v - w‖ ≤ ‖f v - f w‖
